blurb: Guests join high-speed, custom-built vessels for whale watching tours along the Southern California coast. Tours include expert narration and opportunities to see humpback, blue, gray, and killer whales, as well as dolphins and other marine life. Special event cruises include fireworks observation and New Year's Eve celebrations.
